publication_endpoint: test of phase-dependent control handoff: internal readiness at migration activation versus external route opportunity during progression
core_hypothesis: internal migratory readiness primarily gates movement initiation; once movement begins, landscape/barrier opportunity may dominate progression and completion

primary_cohort.rationale: each stage has >=98 individuals across 7 projects with complete WRS-table coverage

boundary_groups.FII: n=17; 16/17 from one project, descriptive boundary only
boundary_groups.silver: coarse stage label; not pooled into ordinal Durif analysis

primary_predictions: capture-time Durif stage predicts migration initiation across fixed post-release windows
the marginal Durif association with final success is substantially attenuated after conditioning descriptively on initiation
barrier/hydrological context explains heterogeneity in post-initiation progression better than a universal stage effect
an independent same-landscape barrier system reproduces external control after gate opening

primary_estimands.initiation: Durif-stage effect on migration initiation at fixed post-release windows
primary_estimands.completion: Durif-stage association with final success among observed initiators, interpreted descriptively
primary_estimands.confirmation: state x opportunity effects in an independent within-landscape system

falsification: independent data fail to reproduce readiness control of migration activation
post-initiation completion remains strongly Durif-dominated after external opportunity is represented
independent barrier/hydrological opportunity contributes little to progression
the apparent WRS completion gradient disappears in within-route data once project confounding is removed
evidence_boundary: Europe-wide outcome and window series are developmental/opened evidence; completion conditioning is not causal mediation; independent barrier/opportunity confirmation remains required.
eog_role: discovery of an extreme resident anchor only

project_context_gate.boundary: project-level context evidence only; WRS is strongly confounded with system identity

post_initiation_speed.boundary: source-paper overall migration-speed definition; developmental result

direct_phase_interaction.boundary: cluster-robust stacked two-phase model; developmental evidence

leave_one_project_out.boundary: direction is project-robust; formal interaction precision depends partly on the 2015 project

initiation.interpretation: advanced Durif state predicts higher probability of opening the movement gate from the first week through three months

completion_given_initiation.interpretation: stage association is strongly attenuated among eels that have already initiated migration; descriptive only, not causal mediation
